name: cache-meter
description: Prompt cache, usage limits and your account at a glance in Claude Code: a band above the prompt and a status line with the fields you choose (account, e-mail, model, effort, mode, cache warm or cold, next message cost, context, hit rate, 5-hour and weekly limits with resets, session cost). Works in the terminal and the desktop app. /cache opens the full breakdown, with an optional Keep Warm. By Eryk Sadowski.

ttl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
ttl.description: auto: 1h on a Claude subscription, 5m on an API key. Set it by hand if you changed promptCacheTtl.

guard.title: Cold send guard
guard.description: Default for every repo. off: nothing. confirm: hold a message sent into a cold cache once and show the price, the resend goes through. warn: only show the price. A repo can keep its own (/cache guard repo on|off), a session too (/cache guard, or the pane).

keepWarm.title: Keep Warm at start
keepWarm.description: Default for every repo. off: no pings. on: every new session starts with Keep Warm on. A repo can keep its own (/cache warm repo on|off), a session too (/cache warm, or the pane).

keepWarmFor.title: Keep Warm for
keepWarmFor.description: How long after your last message Keep Warm goes on pinging. Each ping costs one cache read of the context.

bandFields.title: Band fields
bandFields.description: Fields of the band above the prompt, in order, comma separated. Empty: cache, next, ifcold, context, hit, 5h, 7d, spend, session. All: account, email, model, effort, mode, style, dir, branch, cache, next, ifcold, context, hit, 5h, 7d, spend, session. /cache band ... changes it per account.
bandFields.default: cache, next, ifcold, context, hit, 5h, 7d, spend, session

lineFields.title: Status line fields
lineFields.description: Fields of the status line, in order, comma separated (same names as the band). Empty: account, email, model, effort, 5h, 7d, context. /cache line ... changes it per account.

statusLine.title: Status line under the prompt
statusLine.description: auto: pinned under the prompt wherever no terminal statusLine script draws it (the desktop app among them). on: always pinned. off: never pinned (the terminal script still prints it). /cache line on|off|auto per account.

resetStyle.title: Limit reset as
resetStyle.description: auto: a countdown in the band, the clock time in the status line. countdown: 2d 4h. clock: 14:40, or Sun 05:00 further off. both.

accountLabels.title: Account labels
accountLabels.description: Your own name per config folder, e.g. '.claude=A, .claude-b=Work, .claude-c=3'. Empty: a letter from the folder (.claude is A, .claude-b is B).

alfred.title: Send usage to Alfred
alfred.description: on: at most once a minute per session, send the usage limits, context and model id (never the e-mail) to the local Alfred engine, for its account and context pills.

alfredHome.title: Alfred folder
alfredHome.description: Where alfred-app lives; its data/api.token is the local token.
